migrations.20261009_backfill_agent_sandb: Backfills teamId for legacy agent sandbox instances from their App/Skill source. Orphan records whose source was deleted are skipped and counted; records whose source exists without a teamId are reported as failed records for repair and retry.

Migrate the legacy systemConfigs collection and DB-backed environment variables into the system_instance_configs document model. Nodes stay unready until the migration succeeds.

migrations.20260929_cleanup_instance_con: Clean up deprecated instance config fields
Remove instance config fields that moved to environment variables or are no longer used, so the new schema can resolve every domain.

migrations.20261022_backfill_folder_ance: Rebuild App, tool, and Dataset folder ancestorIds paths from parentId, and remove stale values from non-folders. Records whose parent folder type does not match (app folders vs tool folders) are moved to the root instead of failing the migration; other records that cannot be migrated safely are listed for repair and retry.
Scanned {{scannedCount}} resource records; {{failedCount}} unresolved records remain.
Backfill App and tool folder paths
migrations.20261025_token_prices_per_mil: Migrate system model prices to million units

Reads system models once and saves pricing in one batch. Token/TTS rates are multiplied by 1000; STT rates are copied unchanged. Preserves root-level prices and skips valid existing pricing. Team models are free. Runs in the background; fix invalid data and retry after a failure.
Migrated {{migratedCount}} system models to pricing. Original prices and team models remain unchanged.
migrations.20261022_initialize_dataset_v: First verify and remove the legacy global HNSW index online. Once removal succeeds, count existing Dataset vectors in the background and schedule FP16 partial indexes for Datasets with more than 10,000 vectors. Index jobs run without a delay, one at a time globally. Migration completion does not mean all partial indexes are ready. Exact search remains available while indexes are being built.
Counted {{scannedCount}} datasets; {{eligibleCount}} met the index threshold. Index builds continue in the queue.
Count dataset vectors and schedule index builds
Remove the legacy global HNSW index

migrations.20261104_backfill_openapi_key: Backfill personal and app key types in the background, preserving bindings, credentials, and legacy fields.
migrations.20261110_backfill_external_fi: Derive the check switch from existing domain allowlists while preserving explicit settings and the original list.
migrations.20261111_rehome_subservice_co: Backfill the Code Sandbox connection and MCP SSE switch once, preserving administrator settings and explicitly cleared values.
